steps.text: Mass defect: a nucleus weighs less than its separate nucleons; ΔE = Δm c².
Binding energy per nucleon peaks near iron; fusion and fission both move toward the peak.
Radioactive decay is random and spontaneous; N = N₀e^(−λt).
Half-life is the time for half the nuclei to decay; it does not depend on the starting amount.
Activity A = λN, measured in becquerels.
α, β and γ radiation differ in ionising power and penetration.
